insights.one_liner: Rotterdam-based nonprofit led by Boyan Slat building systems to remove plastic from oceans and rivers, and an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: A global nonprofit developing and scaling technology to rid the oceans of plastic.
Based in Rotterdam (earlier Delft), founded in 2013 and led by CEO Boyan Slat.
Its open role here is an entry-level hardware and engineering job in Rotterdam.

open.text: Both Stichting The Ocean Cleanup and The Ocean Cleanup Operations B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
Its open job needs no Dutch.
Founder Boyan Slat offered a job to an Indian 20-year-old who cleaned a river alone, a story that went viral.

growth.text: Had about 35 staff in 2016 and revenue of about 30.5 million euros in 2019.
Is rolling out river Interceptors in places like the Philippines, Panama and Colombia.

worth_knowing.text: Kia renewed its partnership with The Ocean Cleanup.
Research by UvA's ABW into The Ocean Cleanup won a prize for best publication.
